subject: Governance at 58, and the 45 people behind it
body:
Priya,

Your Vantage Partners assessment put governance at 58, above the median among professional services organisations that have completed it (n=41). Tooling at 74 is your strongest section, so the tools are in place and the oversight is trailing them.

That fits what you wrote about clients asking what your AI capability is. With 45 people in scope, a decision framework is a faster win than more tooling.

Nebius Academy programmes are taught by practitioners who run AI in production, so the frameworks come from people who have had to apply them.

Worth 20 minutes?

Adam
facts_used: stated_priority: Clients keep asking what our AI capability is and I need an answer I can stand behind
